basic_info.description: FREE HOA Dues for 2 YEARS! This one-of-a-kind, rarely available condominium, a coveted corner unit high up on the 12th floor at 1388 Gough, offers luxury and privacy, with floor-ceiling windows and beautiful city views to the north and west. The largest 2-bedroom layout in the building, unit 1201 is located on a very quiet floor with only two other units. This immaculate home showcases an extra-large living room and dining area with stunning views, gleaming hardwood floors, and a remodeled kitchen with custom cabinetry and stainless appliances. Just off the living room is the spacious primary bedroom with remodeled ensuite bath. A second bedroom functions as a tasteful customized office with plenty of space for a guest bed. Just across the hall is another remodeled bathroom with stacked washer/dryer. Included with this condo are 1 car parking and a large storage area.  Owners enjoy a host of premier services including 24/7 concierge and security, secure package receiving, a lovely rear garden oasis, a gym, and guest parking.  Live in the best location between downtown, Hayes Valley, Pacific Heights, Fillmore and Japantown. This turn-key unit is offered empty or completely furnished. You need only unlock the door and move-in to enjoy luxury, views, privacy, and complete comfort.
